Glucagon-like peptide-1 (GLP-1) receptor agonists are effective hypoglycemic agents for type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM). It was reported that T2DM was implicated in pancreatic β-cell senescence. Whether loxenatide regulates cellular senescence of pancreatic β-cells is to be investigated. results.text: Gluco-metabolic response to exogenous oxytocin in totally pancreatectomized patients and healthy individuals. Oxytocin has been proposed to possess glucose-stabilizing effects through the release of insulin and glucagon from the pancreas. Also, exogenous oxytocin has been shown to stimulate extrapancreatic glucagon secretion in depancreatized dogs.
